title: The substitution rule for the second output is not reproduced
body_md: The source describes all three switching modes for the first output only and gives, in a red note, a rule for transferring the same messages to the second output. That rule is not reproduced here because it is part of the blocked command syntax. That both outputs can be switched equivalently is documented; the exact route is an open item.
source_region: Section 5.5.3, red note box at the foot of the page
prev_context: Before this stands switching for a freely selectable time.
next_context: Section 5.6 begins on the next page.
change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 23: equivalent in substance. The omission follows BLK-005 and BLK-006 and is not a language difference.
